teaser.en: Only when an aloe grows a proper trunk do the Digo count it as a tree; until then it is just a very useful rosette.
teaser.sw: Wadigo huhesabu mshubiri kuwa mti pale tu unapootesha shina halisi; hadi hapo ni kichaka cha majani chenye manufaa makubwa tu.

summary.en: *Golonje* is the Digo name for the wild aloes, succulent rosettes with spiny leaves and bitter yellow sap. It is one of the most popular Digo medicines.
summary.sw: *Golonje* ni jina la Kidigo la mishubiri ya porini, mimea yenye majani manene yaliyopangwa kama duara, yenye miiba na utomvu mchungu wa manjano. Ni mojawapo ya dawa za Kidigo zinazopendwa zaidi.

about.en:
*Golonje* grows as a rosette of thick, fleshy leaves edged with sharp teeth. Break a leaf and a bitter yellow sap oozes out, while the inside holds a clear gel.

In the dry season tall spikes rise from the centre of the rosette carrying tubular red or orange flowers, which are visited by sunbirds. Some kinds stay low and stemless, while others grow a short trunk.
about.sw:
*Golonje* hukua kama duara la majani manene yenye nyama, yaliyopakana na meno makali. Ukivunja jani, utomvu mchungu wa manjano hutiririka, huku ndani yake kukiwa na jeli safi.

Wakati wa kiangazi, mashada marefu huchipuka kutoka katikati ya duara la majani yakibeba maua mekundu au ya rangi ya chungwa yenye umbo la mrija, ambayo hutembelewa na ndege chozi. Aina nyingine hubaki chini bila shina, huku nyingine zikiotesha shina fupi.

where.en: Look for *golonje* in rocky bushland and on coral rag, the old raised reef rock behind the coast. The flower spikes make it easy to spot from a distance.
where.sw: Mtafute *golonje* katika vichaka vya miamba na kwenye matumbawe, yaani mwamba wa zamani wa matumbawe ulioinuka nyuma ya pwani. Mashada ya maua huufanya kuwa rahisi kuuona ukiwa mbali.

uses.en: *Golonje* is among the most popular Digo medicines. The Digo of Diani infuse the leaves of several aloe species as a remedy for malaria.
uses.sw: *Golonje* ni miongoni mwa dawa za Kidigo zinazopendwa zaidi. Wadigo wa Diani hulowesha majani ya aina kadhaa za mishubiri kutengeneza dawa ya malaria.

culture.en: The Digo classify plants with care. An aloe is counted among the trees (*mihi*) only once it has grown a stem topped by a rosette; until then it is not considered a tree.
culture.sw: Wadigo huainisha mimea kwa uangalifu. Mshubiri huhesabiwa miongoni mwa miti (*mihi*) pale tu unapootesha shina lenye duara la majani juu yake; hadi hapo hauhesabiwi kuwa mti.

names.en: Digo: *golonje*, a name shared with Duruma and Giriama. English: aloe. In Swahili it is *mshubiri*. *Golonje* covers several species of *Aloe* rather than a single one.
names.sw: Kidigo: *golonje*, jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Kwa Kiingereza: *aloe*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mshubiri*. *Golonje* hujumuisha aina kadhaa za *Aloe* badala ya aina moja tu.

conservation.en: Many wild aloes are protected under international trade rules because they are collected heavily for medicine and gardens.
conservation.sw: Mishubiri mingi ya porini inalindwa chini ya sheria za kimataifa za biashara kwa sababu huvunwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya dawa na bustani.

reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wenye majani manene wa vichaka vikavu

reason.en: Succulent shrub of the same dry habitat
reason.sw: Kichaka chenye majani manene cha mazingira yale yale makavu

reason.en: Also boiled for malaria by the Digo
reason.sw: Pia huchemshwa na Wadigo kwa malaria
Dawa nyingine ya malaria ya Diani
Dawa nyingine ya Kidigo inayothaminiwa sana
